title: GC18R Transactional Groundwater Exchange Canonical Admission Architecture Audit

scope.capability: typed transactional groundwater exchange checkpoint/trial/prepare/abort/commit service with fail-closed revision and exactly-once prepared-publication guards

invariants.basis: one shared groundwater exchange runtime contract serves standalone and coupled compositions without a separate SWAP kernel
service contract owns no files, formats, paths, parsers or file units
checkpoint, candidate, prepared reservation and trial result remain explicit typed transaction categories
reservation registry exists only on preparable services and scales with peak concurrent reservations rather than logical columns
no Newton, Jacobian or constitutive scratch becomes persistent column state
pooled free-list reservation storage supports O(1) reserve/release apart from amortized geometric growth and does not constrain SoA/batching
independent copied-handle tests prove stale commit/abort cannot reach backend publication and abort preserves committed state
prepare refusal and abort preserve committed origin for retry; no failed trial replaces committed state
generic t0,t1 windows retained; no day, month, year or midnight assumption
no fixed coupling-window duration is introduced
transactional groundwater prepare/abort/final publication is admitted as core runtime capability
F-GC17 typed groundwater contract remains byte-identical with q_GW=-q_SWAP and q residual convention preserved
no mass tolerance is introduced and exactly-once publication prevents duplicate committed groundwater exchange
interface sensitivity and response-tangent contracts are untouched
no additional full SWAP coupling trajectories are introduced
no heavy solver instance per column; optional pooled reservation state scales with active use; no throughput benchmark claimed
no one-to-one SWAP-to-MODFLOW-cell relation is encoded
deep-vadose component ownership is untouched
component transition storage/accounting is untouched while duplicate transaction publication is prevented
groundwater exchange service is independent of soil-water solver implementation
crop, ET, drainage, irrigation and surface physics are not duplicated
no HeadCalc internals are exposed
transaction safety/runtime contract does not silently modify physical model options
revision exhaustion and stale prepared handles fail closed; reservation lookup is bounded O(1) apart from amortized growth
reference mode and reference/legacy trees are unchanged
explicit stale-prepared, revision-exhausted and backend statuses make transaction failures diagnosable
non-preparable services pay no reservation-registry cost and optional cost scales with use
runtime/coupler retains system composition and exclusive mutation ownership of one service instance is explicit
no hidden file, calendar, MODFLOW, revision-headroom or backend one-shot assumption remains
owner remediation, independent F-VQ61 and F-CI53 admission all explicitly assess all 30 architecture invariants

hard_nonclaims: No MODFLOW adapter, aquifer solver or physical groundwater response model is admitted.
No end-to-end coupled mass ledger beyond the typed interface and transaction publication contract is admitted.
No full predictor-corrector convergence or crash-recovery protocol is admitted.
No large-batch throughput benchmark is claimed.
